page_title: Free Markdown Viewer for Mac | Imark

summary.name: Imark
summary.one_liner: A free, MIT-licensed Markdown viewer for Mac that opens .md files as clean rendered documents, with an in-place text editor, Quick Look preview, and comments saved into the file.
use_cases: Reading .md files as formatted documents on a Mac
Fixing a single line in a Markdown file without leaving the reader
Previewing Markdown files in Finder with Quick Look
Reviewing and annotating AI agent plans from Claude Code or Codex
Leaving review comments on exact phrases in a Markdown document
Viewing Markdown with Mermaid diagrams and math offline
summary.what_it_does: Imark opens Markdown files in a reading view by default. A pencil button or ⌘E switches to a text view with line numbers, coloured Markdown syntax, find bar, and markers on changed lines; ⌘S saves and refuses the save if the file changed on disk. Selecting a phrase lets you write a note that is stored in the document as an HTML comment, so it travels with the file. It ships a review skill for Claude Code and Codex that opens the agent's plan for annotation. A Quick Look extension renders .md files in Finder, and Mermaid and KaTeX are bundled for diagrams and maths.
notable: Reader-first design with an in-place pencil editor and conflict-safe saving
Comments stored inside the Markdown file as HTML comments, visible in no other app
Review skill for Claude Code and Codex to annotate and approve agent plans
Renders Mermaid and KaTeX offline; documents render without remote requests
caveats: Editing is intended for line-level fixes; larger edits are sent to an external editor
